column1: # Authored by the Tangocho project; distributed with the packs under CC BY-SA
# (docs/data-sources.md). Only for clear errors in JLPT N5-N3 that the learner
# signal and the English-Spanish matching leave; each line puts one of
# KANJIDIC2's own meanings for that kanji and language first (never new text).
# An English line also steers the Spanish order, which follows the English one.
# Columns (tab-separated): kanji, language (en/es), the meaning to put first,
# more meanings to follow it ("; "-separated, may be empty), the reason.

column5: JLPT words favour "middle" (centro); keep "inside" (中に), as in the English list
the verb, as 見 ver and 書 escribir (学ぶ); KANJIDIC2 has no "aprender"
circle and "round" come first; at N5 円 is the yen (百円)
circular comes first; at N5 円 is the yen (百円)
business comes from compounds (仕事); 事 is a thing or matter
care comes from one compound (注意); 意 is idea, mind (意味, 意見)
family comes from compounds (家族); 家 alone is house, home
KANJIDIC2 lists "roof" first; 屋 is the shop of 本屋, 花屋 (and 部屋)
JMdict merges 早い (early) with 速い (fast)
bad comes from compounds (不便); 不 is the negative prefix
change comes from rare compounds; 転 turns, rolls (回転, 運転, 転ぶ)
plan (計画) has no Spanish gloss but "pensar"; 計 measures (時計, 計算)
plan (planear) overtakes the drawing / map sense
ejercitarse relates to "exertion"; 勉 is effort (勉強)
着く (arrive) and 着る (wear) are both N5 words; 着 is taught as clothing first (着る, 着物)
as the English: 着る, 着物 ("usar" also reads as use)
leave comes from 去る; learners meet 去 in 去年 (last year) and 過去
as the English: 去年, 過去
materials comes from 材料; 料 is the fee of 料金, 無料
as the English: 料金, 無料
about is ぐらい (位); 位 is rank, grade
airplane comes from 飛行機; 機 is machine, mechanism (機械)
JMdict lists "mince" first for 刻む; 刻 is carve, engrave (時刻: time)
son comes from 息子; 息 alone is breath
JMdict lists "rescue" first for 助ける; 助 is help (手助け, 助手)
the English list has no "say"; 申す is the humble "say"
error (過ち) overtakes pass, exceed (過ぎる, 過去)
the honorific prefix (御飯, 御手洗い) matches no English gloss
poner is matched to "stance" through a synonym; 構 is build, posture (構造)
sentar bien is a narrow sense of "suit"; 合 fits, matches (合う)
store comes from 収める; 収 is income, obtain (収入)
collision comes from 衝突; learners meet 突 in 突然 (sudden)
the English list has no "group"; 組 is a group, a class (組, 番組)
afirmar (affirm) is matched to "firm"; 確 is certain, sure (確か)
teoría ties with "explicar" and comes first; 説 explains (説明)
realizar relates to "performance"; 演 performs, acts (演技, 演劇)
gustar algo says the same at more length (好き)
bend comes from 曲がる; 曲 alone is a tune, a piece of music (作曲); "music" is 楽's
as the English: a tune (曲, 作曲)
